reviewScope: Independent read-only review of the working diff; Python compilation and generated JavaScript syntax parsing only. No Chromium execution.

newPredicates: final observed text equals expected message

observerReview.tapAndInitialStyleRead: The existing final actual handler call and first computed-style observation occur in the same iframe async evaluate task.
observerReview.clock: iframe performance.now(); elapsed begins immediately before the final actual handler call
observerReview.successCondition: A requestAnimationFrame sample has the exact expected text and all unchanged positive-opacity/geometry conditions within the accepted time window.
observerReview.deadline: A separate observer-owned timeout or an elapsed >= 1000 rAF sample produces outcome=deadline, which fails the Python assertion even if geometry is positive.
observerReview.cleanup: Only the observer-owned requestAnimationFrame id and timeout id are cancelled. Product state.toastTimer is not accessed.
observerReview.productMutation: No new assignment to product text, CSS, opacity, animation, game state or timer. getComputedStyle intentionally flushes styles without assigning a style.
observerReview.expectedTextNotSelfCertifying: The exact-product string is checked against the unchanged mathematical-language assertions in Python, so matching an arbitrary wrong string does not bypass those assertions.

diagnostics.captureMeasurements: read-only iframe samples immediately before and after the screenshot call
diagnostics.preservedOnObserverFailure: The assertion message contains the observation object including initial/firstFrame/final and hostEvaluationDurationMs.

staticValidation.generatedJavaScriptParse: PASS for 11 evaluate/wait_for_function expressions, including concatenated observer and screenshot sampler

limitsAndNextEvidence: Static PASS does not establish that the new CI run passes or prove the cause of the old opacity=0 failures.
The original opacity > 0 threshold is preserved; this gate does not claim full opacity=1 or continuous visibility for the whole toast lifetime.

Success records a real in-frame visibility sample within 200–1000ms. The host may receive it later; the screenshot can therefore occur after that sample. Screenshot timing and actual PNG review remain separate evidence.
The new observer does not continuously trace every opacity mutation or transition event. Initial/first/final samples support timing analysis without proving unseen intermediate events.
A heavily stalled renderer still fails the finite deadline; it is not accepted by extending or resetting the product toast.

Next CI should retain exact script/source hashes, final elapsed/opacity, host evaluation duration, before/after screenshot elapsed/opacity, and screenshot pixels. Physical device and audible speech remain outside scope.
